subject: Literature
title: Shakespeare in Education
description: A micro-lesson that makes Shakespeare in Education usable.

hook.text: Shakespeare is the only writer mandatory in nearly every English-speaking school system on Earth.

buildup.text: Students have been studying his plays as required reading since the nineteenth century across the British Empire.

discovery.text: The educational canon solidified in the Victorian era, when Shakespeare was promoted as morally improving.

twist.text: Many students hate Shakespeare because they read plays silently that were designed to be performed aloud.

climax.text: The debate continues: is mandatory Shakespeare essential cultural literacy or gatekeeping by the literary elite?

punchline.text: The world's greatest playwright is also its most dreaded homework.

quiz.question: Why do many students struggle with Shakespeare?
options: The plays are too short to analyze
They read silently plays designed to be performed aloud
